curl -s "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
models = data.get('data', [])
results = []
for m in models:
    p = m.get('pricing', {})
    p_in = float(p.get('prompt', 0)) * 1_000_000
    p_out = float(p.get('completion', 0)) * 1_000_000
    if p_in > 0 and p_in < 0.084:  # mais barato que nosso modelo no input
        ctx = m.get('context_length', 0)
        name = m.get('name', m.get('id', ''))
        mid = m.get('id', '')
        results.append({
            'id': mid,
            'name': name,
            'in': p_in,
            'out': p_out,
            'ctx': ctx
        })
results.sort(key=[REDACTED] x: x['in'])
print(f'Modelos com input mais barato que \$0.084/M: {len(results)}')
for r in results:
    print(f\"{r['id'][:55]:55} | in: \${r['in']:.4f}/M | out: \${r['out']:.4f}/M | ctx: {r['ctx']}\")
" 2>&1
